about: The p3 re-prove story film v137-dagen-h (run r-pwr3re-0002, 2026-10-27, reverted in d9669be) replayed: a BigNumber held 79 frames. Its Film file is ci/fixtures/film/V137DagenH.tsx (filmlint: RAW_STROKE).

pitches.logline: Every car on Stockholm's Kungsgatan must cross to the other side of the road at dawn. In the way: a country that voted to stay left, and 350,000 signs pointing the old way.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: FreezeTag on the Kungsgatan photo, the claim 04:50 already big. A handbrake yanks and the street freezes mid-move; sound real-handbrake

pitches.logline: In 1955 Sweden votes 83 % to keep driving on the left. In 1967 it switches to the right anyway, in one morning.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the big number 83 % beside the word for left; a red strike slashes through it on frame 2; sound asmr-strike

pitches.logline: A country plans to move every car to the other side of the road in ten minutes. The catch: the people had voted against it.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: ResultFirst, the Kungsgatan crowd already on the right with the claim 10 minutes; a car chorus honks as the photo rewinds; sound horn-chorus

treatment.logline: On 3 September 1967 every car in Sweden must cross from the left side of the road to the right in ten minutes, though the people had voted to stay left.
treatment.hero: The traffic of Kungsgatan on the real 1967 Dagen H photo and its split-flap clock: the same street and the same clock from the hook to the payoff, no invented person
treatment.obstacle: A whole country used to the left, about 350,000 signs pointing the old way, ten minutes to cross, and a people who had voted no

hook.event: 04:50 on the Kungsgatan photo: the street freezes mid-move as a handbrake yanks, the claim 04:50 already big

act1: Until 3 September 1967 Sweden drives on the left; that morning every car has to change sides (the old lane's arrow struck in red on the clock's order)
Worse: about 350,000 road signs had to come down or be replaced (the number rolls, then the real photo of the new signs)
Worst: only ten minutes to cross, 04:50 to 05:00, the gap bracketed between two bars
treatment.turn: The twist: a 1955 paper slammed with the stamp „არა“, then the signature grid fills 83 of 100: the people had voted to stay on the left; a 0.7 s hold on the grid

reveal.what: 05:00: the grid's dot grows into the clock, it rolls on from 04:59 to 05:00 and an ink arrow sweeps right: the cars move off on the right

treatment.payoff: The ledger 1955 to 1967, then the same Kungsgatan photo again, now an arrow on the cars on the right: Sweden crossed anyway; the closing line turns the hook's ten minutes
treatment.signature: Film V137DagenH: a split-flap clock stopped on 04:50, two lane arrows with the old side struck in red, then the clock rolling to 05:00 as an ink arrow sweeps right
